LanguageData.RT_T15_Vehicle.label: T-15 Armata IFV
LanguageData.RT_T15_Vehicle.description:
Heavy tracked IFV on the Armata platform equipped with a 57mm Baikal/Kinzhal unmanned combat module, Kornet ATGMs, and PKTM MG.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1, Passenger x9 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 57mm Baikal Autocannon: 57x348mmSR (AP / AP-HE / Sabot) - Kornet ATGM: 9M133 "Kornet"AntiTank missile(HEAT) - 7.62mm PKTM MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
